rows.concrete_observation: Native natural BlockPedestal creates registered ITickable ShrineCore; update activation and living linked-wizard check periodically call containNearbyTargets. It filters Player/Wizard/EvilWizard in a cube, server attempts potion219 then BOTH sides unconditionally store the shrine position under one containmentPos key. storeTagSafely replaces key unless cyclic; it is not ownership comparison. Potion active tick lazily sets missing centre, radius=15-4*amplifier, checks full body per axis and adds 0.15 signed corrective velocity plus undoGravity when outside; no hard teleport or HP prerequisite. Normal final duration<=1 clears centre, and 20tick LivingUpdate removes orphan tag only without potion. Shrine conquer/regenerate call a cleanup method whose entire body is commented out. Conquest packet64range carries only block XYZ; scheduled client handler finds current TileEntity then calls conquer, which plays conquest FX but does not remove target potion/centre. Thus shown success cue is not control-release receipt. Active containment renderer reads LOCAL player potion plus local centre, fades near plane vertices and last40 duration, not a server reason packet or arbitrary Boss target overlay.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: For temporary control windows verify both owner identity and actual release, not a successful boss/encounter cue. A shared bare centre key can be rewritten by another active shrine or an active spell effect without generation/owner token; potential overlapping-source semantics need runtime verification before designing a change. Completion feedback cannot stand in for final accepted/released state.
rows.semantic_dedup: One native encounter-owned control/centre lifecycle proposal, all shrine production, potion movement, conquest packet and visual consumer merged. Compared prior Wizardry paralysis tail-vs-early release and SlowTime orphan cleanup: this has an independently repeated external producer rewriting origin, no-op explicit teardown, and encounter success cue that is not release. Radius, six planes, eight textures, registry/codec/NBT helpers do not earn separate proposals; Russell may downgrade overlap.
rows.limitations: Static fixed source only; no actual shrine encounter, packet delivery, release duration or overlapped-source reproduction. addPotionEffect admission is inherited and void in this API; do not claim immunity result captured. centre raw entity NBT server-to-client synchronization not closed; local initialization/producer exists on each side but not proof identical centre after late join. Renderer is an annotated CLIENT event subscriber; depth/occlusion/visible pixels not validated. Radius is unclamped for arbitrary amplifiers; no proof ordinary configurations reach negative radius. Conquest method source intentionally read completely, including client branch; no code changes recommended or made before 1000 gate.

PATH/SPARKLE trail is independent of final potion admission. Parent potion base draws HUD/inventory icon and has empty performEffect; concrete containment override provides movement.
